'''Ajaan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as a [[Sith Warrior]] trainer stationed in the [[Sith Sanctum]] on the Imperial capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
